name: Unique characters, wave 2
notes: 24 named crew with an active ability (docs/CONTENT.md section 16): one for each of the twenty newer races (Vellum, Oorth, Drakkin, Wisp, Hullkin, Lantern, Revenant, Choir, Rattler, Tessellate, Sable, Quillback, Kite, Warden-frame, Murrow, Siltborn, Corvin, Brine, Echo, Ferro) and four wanderers found in any region (a lane-lamp AI, a customs clerk, a fire-eater and a drum-major). characters.json is the roster; events/*_chars.json holds one recruit event per character (`recruit: {character}`), placed with requires.region (the homeland) or none (the wanderers, and the Warden-frame, who has no homeland) and stage bands. Eight are hard to get: a fight (char_kharra_house_tug, char_tamsin_the_contract, char_pyracantha_challenge_in_writing), a high price (char_kharra_house_tug, char_rushlight_night_mail, char_filigree_lot_nine) or a chain (char_obliged_late_reply then char_obliged_arrives_yesterday; char_glim_is_it_dusk then char_glim_lights_the_way; char_quoin_the_arch asks for the flag of the Warden reboot quest). The title of each character opens its `lore` (the schema has no title key). File names avoid the suffix core.json, which tests/test_events.gd matches.
